verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent takes a natural-language question, runs at a user-selected effort level (Fastest through Smartest), draws on many source types, and supports iterative follow-up. The Systematic Review workflow, also exposed via API as an end-to-end run, chains search, screening, full-text screening, extraction and a final report, which goes well beyond a single-pass summary. Hands-on reports of incorrect summaries and missed papers lower confidence in output quality but do not contradict the multi-step capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the agent autonomously plans and sequences its investigation steps, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Research Agent's multi-step behavior.
